      My story

      I work on SEO with a growth mindset — not just a keywords mindset.

      For me, SEO isn't only a position in the results. It's understanding the market, building the right page structure, fixing the technical foundation and shaping an experience that turns the visit into value.

      Who am I?

      I'm Omar Ahmed Ezzeldeen, an SEO Specialist based in Cairo. I've worked on 40+ websites and apps — e-commerce, insurance, telecom, medical, education, food, beauty and fashion — in-house at Makaseb, at ACE Digital Marketing, with a programmatic SEO team in Dubai and as a freelancer.

      Degree: Bachelor's in Accounting, Benha University (2021–2024).
